title: I Bought Claude Max & Started Building my Dream PvPvE Extraction RPG. Now I Need People to Play it With
author: zanemoore575
selftext:
Hey all!

Zane here :)  
I’ve been going hard on something I’m really proud of, and I’d love some fresh eyes on it.

# Nightfall

A Dark Fantasy PvPvE Extraction RPG set in the cursed castle of Dawnhold, once a city blessed by light. Up to four raiders go in to uncover what happened there, find powerful relics, fight the dead and each other, and get out before the sixth bell.

The idea is to take the epic class fantasy of classic RPGs (WoW-style controls, abilities, talents and specialisations for each class) and blend it with the tension of an extraction game, where you can lose your best gear. The map is the main character: you learn more about Dawnhold every time you go in.

A few things that make it its own:

\- Light keeps you safer from the dead, who grow stronger in the dark. But your lantern also shows you to other players.  
\- As the night goes on, the bells ring from within the castle. Lights fail, the dead wake, and anyone still inside at the sixth bell is consumed by the dark   
\- The story is told through places and items, never cutscenes.

**How it's made:** it's my first game. I'm building it in Godot 4 with Claude Code writing most of the code while I design and direct, and learning as I go. The 3D art comes from asset packs and the icons are AI-generated.

It's still early, but I'm gathering people in the Discord for our first playtest. If you'd like to be among the first into Dawnhold and help shape the game, come join 👇

[discord.gg/EN933HVEb](http://Discord)

I'd especially love to know: what would make you want to try it?
